t_advice_summary_textbox.text: The pairs that the gnomes appear are in fixed pairs.  Orange will always be with brown, green will always be with pink, red will always be with yellow and blue will always be with purple.Each gnome in each pair will lead you to a different forest.  One to a bright forest with red basket and the other to a dark forest with yellow basket.  Orange, green, red and blue will take you to the bright forest whilst the others take you to the dark one.Try to consistently go to the forest with the most mushrooms.

vb_textbox.text: Hello,I'll try and make this advice as brief as possible, whilst still being able to help as much as I can.There are a few things you should know about this game.Firstly, the gnomes appear in fixed pairs.  Orange and Brown, Green and Pink, Red and Yellow, Blue and Purple.Secondly, each gnome within a pair will guide you to a different forest.  Orange, Green, Red & Blue will guide you to a bright forest with a red basket and Brown, Pink, Yellow & Purple guide you to a darker forest with a yellow basket.Once you find a gnome that has a good amount of mushrooms, stick to the same grouping as the paragraph above.  When the number of mushrooms goes down a fair bit, consider changing the grouping and you can build the points back up again.  Good luck
